header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.arabic_text: يَقُوْلُ: مَنْ اَخَافَ اَهْلَ الْمَدِيْنَةِ فَقَدْ اَخَافَ مَا بَيْنَ جَنْبَيَّ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه احمد ورجاله رجال الصحيح مجمع الزوائد: ٣ /٦٥٨
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Jabir ibn Abdullah (RA) narrates that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “Whoever frightens the people of Madinah has certainly frightened me.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْكُمْ اَنْ يَمُوْتَ بِالْمَدِيْنَةِ، فَلْيَمُتْ بِالْمَدِيْنَةِ فَاِنِّيْ اَشْفَعُ لِمَنْ مَاتَ بِهَا.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “If any of you is able to die in Madinah, he (should try to die in Madinah). Whoever dies in Madinah and is buried in Madinah itself, I will intercede for him.”

blocks.text: Explanation:- The scholars have written that the intercession here is a special, particular intercession, because the general intercession of the Prophet ﷺ is for all Muslims. The meaning of trying and being able is to stay there (in Madinah) until one dies.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ اَنَّ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: لَا يَصْبِرُ عَلَي لَأْوَاءِ الْمَدِيْنَةِ وَشِدَّتِهَا اَحَدٌ مِنْ اُمَّتِيْ اِلَّا كُنْتُ لَهُ شَفِيْعًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ اَوْ شَهِيْدًا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب الترغيب في سكني المدينة ...رقم:٣٣٤٧
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever from my Ummah bears patiently the hardships that come in Madinah and stays here, I will intercede for him on the Day of Qiyamah, or I will be a witness for him”, Rasulullah ﷺ said, as narrated by Hazrat
